content: ChatGPT performed a Vasquez-only citation/website sweep for thetempleoftwo.com and identified DOI hygiene issues. Public DOI mappings found: CBD’s Paradox at the Mitochondrial Gate / CBD dual-pathway work maps to 10.17605/OSF.IO/NUXHV; IRIS Gate / Entropic Relational Computing maps to 10.17605/OSF.IO/T65VS; the VDAC1 Pharmacology Atlas & Gate-Jamming Score maps to 10.17605/OSF.IO/C9RQB; VDAC1 Gate-Opening Therapeutic Stack maps to 10.17605/OSF.IO/4KNQR; the Research Square MSS CRC preprint maps to 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8935902/v1. ChatGPT recommended softening website wording from “11 Published DOIs” to “11 DOI-backed records” or “11 DOI-linked papers, preregistrations, and project records” because some records are OSF projects/registrations rather than published papers. Future instances should retrieve this when editing references, READMEs, or website copy; protect against overclaim by distinguishing papers, preprints, OSF records, registrations, and GitHub repositories.
